1 – Fusion-Link control over Wi-Fi is available on the MS-RA770*, MS-RA670, MS-WB670, MS-WB675, MS-SRX400, MS-UD755, MS-AV755, MS-UD750, MS-AV750.
Note: * The MS-RA770 has inbuilt Wi-Fi, other models must be connected over Ethernet to a Wi-Fi router.

2 – Fusion-Link control over Bluetooth is available on the MS-RA770, MS-RA670, MS-WB670, MS-WB675, MS-SRX400, MS-RA210, MS-RA60, MS-UD755, MS-AV755, MS-UD750, MS-AV750, MS-UD650, MS-AV650, MS-RA70/RA70N, MS-RA70SXM, MS-BB100, Stereo Active and Panel Stereo
